jobs.title: Senior Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate about environmental stewardship ? As the Senior Environmental Specialist , you will p rovide technical input on environmental monitoring and design or construction methods to ensure compliance with environmental specifications or regulatory standards.

B ring your diverse ideas to build stronger, more resilient communities.

Apply now and transform your career with us.

What You Will Be Doing

Audits, analyzes, and reports environmental performance to clients and regulatory bodies.
Advises design and construction teams on minimizing environmental impacts.
Manages subcontractors for specific environmental tasks.
Conducts impact assessments to mitigate environmental risks and costs.
Prepares environmental reports for supervisor and leadership review.
Raises awareness of emerging environmental issues across the organization and e ngages in environmental education and research .
Coordinates public hearings and consultations on environmental matters.
Trains staff on environmental responsibilities.

What We Are Looking For

Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Engineering or an environmental related field required.
Environmental certification preferred.
3+ years’ experience or training in environmental regulatory and construction industry compliance preferred.
CPESC Certification (CA QSP) preferred.
Knowledge of the local regulations or skill sets related to the specific work on project
Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and new legislation
Technical writing and communication skills
Able to lead a team or project effort.
Able to manage subcontractors for project specific specialty environmental work .

Why work for us

Some of the benefits you may be eligible for as an employee are:

Comprehensive compensation package and paid time off program
Industry leading 401(k)/RRSP
Medical/Extended Health Care, Dental, Vision and/or Provincial Medical
Wellness benefits & Employee Assistance Program
Tuition Reimbursement Program

We are an EEO/ADA/Veterans employer.

Salary Min

USD $85,000.00/Yr.

Salary Max

USD $98,500.00/Yr.
